Subject: Proposed compromise language + operational checklist

Kim / Julia — attaching Redwood's proposed compromise. Key points in the draft (see redwood-proposed-indemnity-20250109.docx):

1) Defense control: Redwood will have the right to assume and conduct defense of claims solely for matters that allege Redwood's infringement of third-party IP. If Redwood elects to assume defense, it will do so at its expense and with counsel of Redwood's choice; customer may assume defense only where Redwood fails to reasonably defend or there is a conflict of interest.

2) Evidence staging: Upon receipt of notice, Redwood will acknowledge within 48 hours and provide an initial evidence snapshot within 10 business days (logs / retention metadata / model version hash). For complex requests we will run a prioritized triage and agree on a phased delivery cadence.

3) Liability cap: for third-party IP claims, liability will be capped at the greater of (a) fees paid under the Order Form in the prior 12 months and (b) $500,000.

4) Insurance/offset: Redwood requests acknowledgement that insurance proceeds will offset indemnity payments and to preserve an option for remediation in lieu of payment where appropriate.

Operational checklist (short):
- Assign evidence custodian: Ops Lead (TBD) + contact info to order form appendix.
- Triage owner: Ben Carter (ops) will respond to notice, call with customer security/legal within 24 hours of claim notice.
- Evidence storage: snapshot to be staged in retention bucket; custodian to attach manifest to chain of custody.

Julia — would that approach address your team's practical needs? If you want, we can also produce a short example manifest that the order form references.
